name: Bar
summary: One categorical family for grouped, stacked, radial, target, overlay, and uncertainty comparisons.
inputHint: Choose a visualization-only, supplied-P, independent raw, summary-statistics, paired, or qPCR ΔCt workflow. Inference requires biological IDs or explicit n.

guidance.definition: 以共同基线上的长度编码类别汇总量；同一数据契约可切换分组、堆叠、百分比、双向、分面、极坐标、目标线、断轴、双轴和叠加表达。柱形仍代表汇总量，而不是完整原始分布。
guidance.suitableData: 离散类别的计数、比例、均值或其他汇总值；可输入预先计算的 SD/SEM，也可由长表重复观测计算。Bullet 需要目标值，叠加/双轴需要第二数值，显著性标记需要有效 P 值。
guidance.answers: 类别间大小、组成、方向、分层差异或相对目标的偏离。百分比图回答组成而非绝对量；双轴仅用于单位明确且必须同时展示的指标。
guidance.origin: William Playfair 在 1786 年的《Commercial and Political Atlas》中用柱形比较贸易量，奠定了现代统计柱状图的形式。

references.citation: Friendly, 2008. A Brief History of Data Visualization. Handbook of Data Visualization.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.
Cumming, Fidler & Vaux, 2007. Error bars in experimental biology. J Cell Biol.

name: Line
summary: Time-course or ordered trend with multiple series and visible markers.
inputHint: One row per ordered estimate. Map SD or SEM plus sample size to calculate reference-series Welch tests at each X value, or display uncertainty without testing.

guidance.definition: 按实际 X 采样值的自然顺序连接相邻估计值，以位置和线段方向编码连续变化；可将预先计算的 SD、SEM 或 95% CI 半宽显示为逐点误差棒或连续不确定性带。
guidance.suitableData: 具有自然顺序的时间、剂量或阶段数据；每行应是一个估计值。若计算逐时间点显著性，必须提供均值、SD 或 SEM、显式样本量 n 和分组，并明确数据不是配对或重复测量。
guidance.answers: 指标随顺序如何变化，不同序列的方向、速度或响应模式是否不同，以及已给定的不确定性范围有多大。可选 Welch 检验只回答各时间点相对参考组的独立样本差异，不检验整体时间×组交互。
guidance.origin: Playfair 同样在 1786 年用时间序列折线展示贸易变化，使“随时间阅读趋势”成为统计图形的核心用途。

references.citation: Friendly, 2008. A Brief History of Data Visualization. Handbook of Data Visualization.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.
Cumming, Fidler & Vaux, 2007. Error bars in experimental biology. J Cell Biol.

name: Scatter
summary: Compact association views from points and marginals to fitted, dense, three-axis, and compositional encodings.
inputHint: One row per observation. X and Y are required; Z is additionally required for pair-matrix, 3D, and ternary views.

guidance.definition: 把观察对象映射到二维位置；可叠加边际分布、二维密度、六边形计数、协方差椭圆、凸包、三变量散点矩阵、正交 3D 投影或三元组成坐标。每种变体回答的问题不同，并非装饰性切换。
guidance.suitableData: 标准视图需要两个连续变量；pair-matrix 与 3D 需要第三个连续变量；ternary 需要三个非负且每行总和大于零的组成分量。分组可决定颜色以及拟合/统计是合并还是组内计算。
guidance.answers: 变量的联合分布、局部密度、非线性趋势、组内包络、三变量关系或三部分组成权衡是什么。3D 投影会损失深度判断，ternary 只表示相对组成。

references.citation: Anscombe, 1973. Graphs in Statistical Analysis. The American Statistician.
Cleveland, 1979. Robust Locally Weighted Regression and Smoothing Scatterplots. Journal of the American Statistical Association.
Carr et al., 1987. Scatterplot Matrix Techniques for Large N. Journal of the American Statistical Association.
Aitchison, 1986. The Statistical Analysis of Compositional Data. Chapman and Hall.

name: PCA
summary: Plot supplied principal-component coordinates or calculate PCA locally from a wide feature matrix.
inputHint: Choose supplied coordinates when PCA was calculated upstream, or matrix calculation when the first column identifies features and remaining columns are observations.

guidance.definition: 一种线性无监督降维方法，把高维数据旋转到相互正交、按解释方差由高到低排列的主成分轴；scores 表示观察对象，loadings 表示特征对各轴的贡献。
guidance.suitableData: 高维特征×观察矩阵，如组学、影像特征、形态学、光谱、传感器或标准化临床特征。矩阵模式会透明记录过滤、变换、中心化与缩放。
guidance.answers: 主要变异轴是什么，观察对象是否聚集、分离或存在离群点，哪些特征推动这些轴，以及分组或批次是否与总体结构相关。Scree 图用于判断方差在各主成分间如何分配。
guidance.origin: Karl Pearson 于 1901 年提出空间点的最佳拟合直线与平面，Harold Hotelling 在 1933 年进一步建立并命名主成分分析。

references.citation: Jolliffe & Cadima, 2016. Principal component analysis: a review and recent developments. Phil Trans R Soc A.
Anderson, 2001. A new method for non-parametric multivariate analysis of variance. Austral Ecology.

name: Box
summary: Median, IQR, whiskers, and all observations without hiding sample size.
inputHint: Long format: one row per observation.

guidance.definition: 用中位数、上下四分位数、四分位距和按规则定义的“须”概括分布；须不一定代表最小值和最大值。
guidance.suitableData: 一个或多个分组下的连续原始观测值。
guidance.answers: 各组的中位数、四分位范围、离群值和整体离散程度有何不同。
guidance.origin: John Tukey 在探索性数据分析中推广箱线图；McGill、Tukey 与 Larsen 于 1978 年讨论了缺口和变宽等变体。

references.citation: McGill, Tukey & Larsen, 1978. Variations of Box Plots. The American Statistician.

name: Violin
summary: Kernel-density distribution with median and raw observations.
inputHint: Long format. At least three values per group are recommended.

guidance.definition: 把核密度估计沿中心轴镜像形成“琴身”，并可叠加中位数、箱线或原始点来展示分布形状。
guidance.suitableData: 各组具有足够观测数的连续数据，适合展示分布密度。
guidance.answers: 各组分布的形状、偏态、长尾或多峰特征是否不同。
guidance.origin: Hintze 与 Nelson 在 1998 年提出 violin plot，意图把箱线图的稳健摘要与密度轨迹结合起来。

references.citation: Hintze & Nelson, 1998. Violin Plots: A Box Plot-Density Trace Synergism. The American Statistician.

name: Volcano
summary: Effect size versus significance with explicit FC and FDR thresholds.
inputHint: Use adjusted P values when available; values must be greater than zero.

guidance.definition: 以效应量（常为 log₂ fold change）为 X，以 −log₁₀(P 值或 FDR) 为 Y 的差异结果散点图。
guidance.suitableData: 每个特征具有效应量和 P 值或校正 P 值的差异分析结果。
guidance.answers: 哪些特征同时具有较大的变化幅度和较强的统计证据，变化方向是什么。
guidance.origin: 它在高通量差异表达分析中流行，点云常形成火山轮廓；Li 在 2012 年系统总结了这种图的统计解释。

references.citation: Li, 2012. Volcano Plots in Analyzing Differential Expressions with mRNA Microarrays. J Bioinform Comput Biol.

name: Heatmap
summary: Compact expression matrix with row scaling and a centered diverging scale.
inputHint: First column is the row label; remaining columns must be numeric samples.

guidance.definition: 把数值矩阵的每个单元格映射为颜色；如果未启用聚类，行列顺序完全由输入数据决定。
guidance.suitableData: 行列结构明确的数值矩阵，可使用原始尺度或经过合理标准化的值。
guidance.answers: 二维矩阵中哪些区域呈现高低模式、梯度、块状结构或异常值。
guidance.origin: 矩阵着色可追溯到 19 世纪统计图形；Wilkinson 与 Friendly 的历史综述梳理了它发展为现代热图的过程。

references.citation: Wilkinson & Friendly, 2009. The History of the Cluster Heat Map. The American Statistician.
Gu, Eils & Schlesner, 2016. Complex heatmaps reveal patterns and correlations in multidimensional genomic data. Bioinformatics.

name: Enrichment dot
summary: Term, ratio, count, and FDR encoded independently and legibly.
inputHint: One row per precomputed term with tested background, ratio, count, and FDR. Ratios may be decimals or fractions such as 8/40; this module does not run enrichment.

guidance.definition: 每个功能条目用一个点表示，通常以位置编码富集比例、点大小编码命中数、颜色编码校正 P 值。
guidance.suitableData: 预计算富集结果表，包含条目、明确测试背景、富集比例、命中数量和 FDR；数据库版本与多重校正方法应保存在分析记录中。
guidance.answers: 哪些功能条目同时具有较强统计证据、较高富集比例和足够命中数量。
guidance.origin: 这种多通道编码随着 clusterProfiler 等富集分析工具普及，用一个点同时压缩展示效应、规模和统计证据。

references.citation: Yu et al., 2012. clusterProfiler: an R package for comparing biological themes among gene clusters. OMICS.

name: Correlation
summary: Association views with explicit Pearson or Spearman statistics, optional P values, fitted curves, and confidence bands.
inputHint: One row per paired observation. X and Y are required; Z is additionally required for pair-matrix, 3D, and ternary views.

guidance.definition: 在成对数值的可视分布基础上，用 Pearson r 或 Spearman ρ 量化方向与强度；可选 P 值明确标注为 Pearson t 检验或 Spearman 的渐近 t 近似。
guidance.suitableData: 成对连续或有序数值；Pearson 适合近似线性且无强影响点的关系，Spearman 适合单调关系或秩数据。组内模式要求每组有足够样本。
guidance.answers: 两变量关系的方向、强度与在指定检验假设下的兼容性如何；P 值不等于效应大小，相关也不说明因果。

references.citation: Anscombe, 1973. Graphs in Statistical Analysis. The American Statistician.
Student, 1908. The Probable Error of a Correlation Coefficient. Biometrika.
Cleveland, 1979. Robust Locally Weighted Regression and Smoothing Scatterplots. Journal of the American Statistical Association.

name: MA
summary: Mean abundance versus log2 fold change with FDR and effect-size highlighting.
inputHint: Use a positive baseMean/mean-expression column, log2 fold change, and adjusted P value.

guidance.definition: 以平均丰度 A 为横轴、两条件的对数比值 M 为纵轴，检查效应量是否随总体信号强度变化。
guidance.suitableData: 每个特征具有平均丰度、效应量及统计证据的差异分析结果。
guidance.answers: 变化幅度是否依赖总体丰度，低丰度区域是否存在偏差或异常波动。
guidance.origin: M–A 表示 log ratio 与 mean average，这种图在早期双通道微阵列归一化和强度依赖偏差诊断中形成。

references.citation: Yang et al., 2002. Normalization for cDNA microarray data. Nucleic Acids Res.

name: Quadrant
summary: Two-dimensional comparison divided by independently adjustable X and Y thresholds.
inputHint: One row per item with numeric X/Y values; group and label are optional.

guidance.definition: 用一条 X 阈值线和一条 Y 阈值线把散点图分成四个决策区域，以比较两套量化结果的一致与不一致。
guidance.suitableData: 同一对象的两套效应量、评分或测量值，并具有可解释的 X/Y 阈值。
guidance.answers: 两套结果在哪些区域一致或不一致，哪些对象跨越预设决策阈值。

references.citation: Anscombe, 1973. Graphs in Statistical Analysis. The American Statistician.

name: Error bar
summary: Mean points with symmetric SD or SEM intervals and no compulsory bars.
inputHint: Map a mean and an already-calculated non-negative SD or SEM column.

guidance.definition: 用中心标记配合端帽线段表示估计值及其不确定性或离散程度；必须明确线段是 SD、SEM 还是置信区间。
guidance.suitableData: 类别汇总值及对应的非负 SD 或 SEM；误差类型必须事先明确。
guidance.answers: 各组中心估计及其变异或估计精度如何，不替代原始数据分布。

references.citation: Cumming, Fidler & Vaux, 2007. Error bars in experimental biology. J Cell Biol.

name: Area
summary: Ordered trajectories with restrained translucent fills and visible outlines.
inputHint: Long format with numeric X, numeric value, and optional series.

guidance.definition: 在有序 X 上绘制折线并填充到基线的面积，以强调总量、累计量或趋势的视觉重量。
guidance.suitableData: 有序 X 上的连续数值或多条序列，适合强调整体量级或累积变化。
guidance.answers: 趋势和总体量级如何随顺序变化；重叠面积较多时不适合精确组间比较。
guidance.origin: Playfair 的早期经济时间序列图已经使用线下填充来强调盈余与赤字，成为现代面积图的前身。

references.citation: Friendly, 2008. A Brief History of Data Visualization. Handbook of Data Visualization.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Lollipop
summary: Compact ranked values using stems and emphasized endpoints.
inputHint: One row per category with a numeric value and optional group.

guidance.definition: 用从基线伸出的细杆和末端圆点编码数值，保留柱状图的共同基线，同时降低大面积色块的视觉重量。
guidance.suitableData: 类别对应的单个数值、效应量、评分或排名。
guidance.answers: 项目的排序、极端值和相对大小是什么，同时减少实心柱的视觉重量。
guidance.origin: 这种形状后来被基因组学借用于蛋白结构上的突变位置图；本工具的 Lollipop 是更通用的类别—数值图。

references.citation: Jay & Brouwer, 2016. Lollipops in the Clinic: Information Dense Mutation Plots for Precision Medicine. PLoS ONE.

name: Beeswarm
summary: Deterministically packed raw observations without an enclosing box.
inputHint: Long format: one row per raw observation. At least three values per group are recommended.

guidance.definition: 把每个原始观察值画成点，并在分类轴方向进行防重叠排列；点群宽度来自排布，不是核密度估计。
guidance.suitableData: 样本量较小或中等的分组连续数据，希望保留每一个原始观察点。
guidance.answers: 数据实际分散在哪里，是否存在重复、空档、离群点和组内异质性。

references.citation: Weissgerber et al., 2015. Beyond Bar and Line Graphs: Time for a New Data Presentation Paradigm. PLoS Biol.

name: Raincloud
summary: Density, raw observations, and compact summaries in one layered view.
inputHint: Long format: one row per raw observation. At least three values per group are recommended.

guidance.definition: 把半小提琴密度“云”、原始观察点“雨”和箱线或区间摘要组合在同一组中。
guidance.suitableData: 分组连续原始数据，且希望同时展示密度、稳健汇总和单个观察。
guidance.answers: 组间中心趋势、分布形状和个体变异能否同时得到支持。
guidance.origin: Allen 等人于 2019 年系统整理并命名 raincloud plot，用一个视图同时保留分布、原始数据和汇总统计。

references.citation: Allen et al., 2021. Raincloud plots: a multi-platform tool for robust data visualization. Wellcome Open Res.

name: Histogram
summary: Deterministically binned frequency distributions for grouped observations.
inputHint: Long format: one row per raw observation. At least three values per group are recommended.

guidance.definition: 把连续数值划入等宽区间，以每个区间的频数绘制相邻矩形；图形形状会随箱数改变。
guidance.suitableData: 单组或多组连续原始观测，可按分组与分面比较；应报告箱数或箱宽。
guidance.answers: 数据集中在哪些范围，是否偏态、多峰、长尾或存在稀疏区间。

references.citation: Scott, 1979. On optimal and data-based histograms. Biometrika.
Weissgerber et al., 2015. Beyond Bar and Line Graphs: Time for a New Data Presentation Paradigm. PLoS Biol.

name: Density
summary: Kernel-density estimates with explicit bandwidth and optional raw-data layers.
inputHint: Long format: one row per raw observation. At least three values per group are recommended.

guidance.definition: 用核函数平滑每个观察值并求和，得到连续概率密度估计；曲线面积而非高度总和对应 1。
guidance.suitableData: 具有足够样本量的连续原始观测；带宽必须可追踪并避免把小样本的平滑形状当作真实结构。
guidance.answers: 分布的整体形状、偏态、峰和尾部如何，且这些形状对带宽是否稳定。

references.citation: Silverman, 1986. Density Estimation for Statistics and Data Analysis. Chapman and Hall.
Hintze & Nelson, 1998. Violin Plots: A Box Plot-Density Trace Synergism. The American Statistician.

name: Ridge
summary: Overlapping kernel-density profiles arranged as compact ridgelines.
inputHint: Long format: one row per raw observation. At least three values per group are recommended.

guidance.definition: 把多个密度曲线沿分类轴错开排列，以紧凑方式比较许多组的分布轮廓。
guidance.suitableData: 多个有序或可比较分组的连续原始观测，尤其适合时间点、剂量层级或细胞群。
guidance.answers: 分布位置与形状如何沿组别移动；曲线重叠较多时不适合精确读取单个密度值。

references.citation: Silverman, 1986. Density Estimation for Statistics and Data Analysis. Chapman and Hall.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: PCoA
summary: Publication-ready display of principal-coordinate scores from a documented distance analysis.
inputHint: Upload precomputed PCoA coordinates and document the upstream distance metric; coordinates are never silently recomputed.

guidance.definition: 从样本间距离或相异度矩阵出发，通过特征分解构造低维坐标；它不是直接对原始特征矩阵做 PCA。
guidance.suitableData: 由明确距离或相异度度量得到的 PCoA 坐标，常见于生态、微生物群、组成或其他距离型数据。
guidance.answers: 在所选距离定义下，各观察对象的相似性结构和组间分离情况如何。
guidance.origin: J. C. Gower 在 1966 年系统阐述了从距离关系恢复主坐标的数学性质，因此 PCoA 也常称为 Gower 主坐标分析。

references.citation: Gower, 1966. Some distance properties of latent root and vector methods used in multivariate analysis. Biometrika.
Anderson, 2001. A new method for non-parametric multivariate analysis of variance. Austral Ecology.

name: UMAP
summary: Publication-ready display of a precomputed UMAP embedding.
inputHint: Upload precomputed UMAP coordinates; preserve the upstream seed, neighbors, minimum distance, and metric in your analysis record.

guidance.definition: 一种非线性流形学习方法，先构建高维邻域图，再寻找尽量保留局部邻域结构的低维嵌入。
guidance.suitableData: 高维数据上游计算得到的 UMAP 坐标，如单细胞、多组学、影像或表型特征。
guidance.answers: 局部邻域、亚群和异质性结构如何；不宜把远距离直接解释为定量差异。
guidance.origin: McInnes 等人在 2018 年发布 UMAP，把黎曼几何与拓扑思想转化为可扩展的通用降维算法。

references.citation: McInnes et al., 2018. UMAP: Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection. JOSS.
Anderson, 2001. A new method for non-parametric multivariate analysis of variance. Austral Ecology.

name: t-SNE
summary: Publication-ready display of a precomputed t-SNE embedding.
inputHint: Upload precomputed t-SNE coordinates; preserve the upstream seed, perplexity, metric, initialization, and iterations.

guidance.definition: t-SNE 以高维与低维邻域概率分布之间的差异为目标进行非线性嵌入；本模块只展示上游已计算坐标，不重新拟合。
guidance.suitableData: 由记录了随机种子、perplexity、距离度量、初始化与迭代设置的 t-SNE 流程产生的样本或细胞坐标。
guidance.answers: 局部邻域和潜在亚群在所给嵌入中如何组织。簇间距离、簇面积与全局方向通常没有直接定量含义。
guidance.origin: van der Maaten 与 Hinton 于 2008 年以重尾 Student t 分布缓解拥挤问题，形成今天广泛使用的 t-SNE。

references.citation: van der Maaten & Hinton, 2008. Visualizing Data using t-SNE. JMLR.
Anderson, 2001. A new method for non-parametric multivariate analysis of variance. Austral Ecology.

name: NMDS
summary: Publication-ready display of precomputed non-metric multidimensional scaling coordinates.
inputHint: Upload precomputed NMDS coordinates; preserve the dissimilarity, dimensions, starts, convergence, and stress.

guidance.definition: 非度量多维尺度分析仅要求低维距离保持原始相异度的秩次关系，通过最小化 stress 得到配置；本模块展示预计算结果。
guidance.suitableData: 由明确相异度（如 Bray–Curtis）和多次随机起点得到的 NMDS 坐标，并应同时记录维数、收敛状态与 stress。
guidance.answers: 在相异度排序意义下样本结构、梯度和组间重叠如何；轴方向与绝对尺度本身通常没有固定含义。
guidance.origin: Kruskal 于 1964 年系统建立非度量多维尺度分析与 stress 优化框架，使秩次相异度能够映射到低维空间。

references.citation: Kruskal, 1964. Nonmetric multidimensional scaling: a numerical method. Psychometrika.
Anderson, 2001. A new method for non-parametric multivariate analysis of variance. Austral Ecology.

name: Clustered heatmap
summary: Matrix heatmap with explicit, deterministic row and column clustering.
inputHint: First column supplies row labels; every remaining column must be numeric.

guidance.definition: 先按指定距离和连接方法对行列进行层次聚类，再按树状图顺序重排热图；颜色和树结构表达的是两层信息。
guidance.suitableData: 可比较的数值矩阵；行列聚类前应明确缩放、距离和连接方法。
guidance.answers: 哪些行或列具有相似模式，是否形成候选亚群、模块或共变结构。
guidance.origin: 聚类热图有更早的统计学前身；Eisen 等人在 1998 年把它用于全基因组表达模式后，使其成为组学分析的经典图形。

references.citation: Eisen et al., 1998. Cluster analysis and display of genome-wide expression patterns. PNAS.
Wilkinson & Friendly, 2009. The History of the Cluster Heat Map. The American Statistician.
Gu, Eils & Schlesner, 2016. Complex heatmaps reveal patterns and correlations in multidimensional genomic data. Bioinformatics.

name: Correlation heatmap
summary: Pearson or Spearman correlation calculated across numeric columns and displayed as a symmetric matrix.
inputHint: First column supplies row labels; every remaining column must be numeric.

guidance.definition: 以同一组变量同时作为行和列，用颜色编码每对变量的相关系数，因此矩阵通常对称且对角线为 1。
guidance.suitableData: 同一批观察上测量的多个连续或有序变量。
guidance.answers: 变量之间的相关方向、强度、冗余和潜在模块结构是什么。
guidance.origin: Friendly 在 2002 年提出 corrgram 体系，强调同时用颜色、顺序和符号阅读相关矩阵结构。

references.citation: Friendly, 2002. Corrgrams: Exploratory Displays for Correlation Matrices. The American Statistician.
Gu, Eils & Schlesner, 2016. Complex heatmaps reveal patterns and correlations in multidimensional genomic data. Bioinformatics.

name: Enrichment bar
summary: Ranked pathway bars with FDR encoded by a continuous color scale.
inputHint: One row per precomputed term with tested background, ratio, and FDR; ratios may be decimals or fractions such as 8/40. This module does not run enrichment.

guidance.definition: 每个功能条目对应一根横向或纵向柱，柱长编码富集比例、计数或效应量，主要用于清晰排序。
guidance.suitableData: 可排序的预计算富集结果表，至少包含条目、明确测试背景、富集比例和 FDR。
guidance.answers: 最主要的富集条目如何排序，其效应或富集程度有多大。

references.citation: Yu et al., 2012. clusterProfiler: an R package for comparing biological themes among gene clusters. OMICS.

name: GSEA
summary: Running enrichment score with ranked-position hit ticks.
inputHint: Use the running-score output of a documented GSEA workflow; hit must be 0/1. The plotter does not invent NES or FDR.

guidance.definition: 沿完整的排序特征列表计算运行和统计量，并标出基因集成员命中位置和 leading-edge 区域。
guidance.suitableData: 基于完整排序列表计算的运行富集分数和基因集命中位置。
guidance.answers: 一个基因集主要富集在排序列表的哪一端，驱动富集的命中集中在哪里。
guidance.origin: Subramanian 等人在 2005 年系统提出 GSEA，目的是避免只依赖任意显著性阈值截取基因列表。

references.citation: Subramanian et al., 2005. Gene set enrichment analysis: a knowledge-based approach. PNAS.

name: GO circle
summary: Circular GO term overview grouped by BP, CC, and MF with count and FDR encodings.
inputHint: Use precomputed GO enrichment results. Supply ontology, gene ratio, hit count, FDR, and tested background size; this module does not run enrichment.

guidance.definition: 把预计算 GO 条目排列在装饰性圆周上，以颜色表示 FDR、圆面积近似表示命中数，并保留 BP、CC、MF 本体分组。
guidance.suitableData: 具有明确背景基因数、Gene ratio、命中数和 FDR 的 GO 富集结果；本模块不执行富集检验。
guidance.answers: 哪些 GO 条目在三个本体分支中具有更强证据或更多命中；圆周位置不表示条目相似度。

references.citation: Ashburner et al., 2000. Gene Ontology: tool for the unification of biology. Nature Genetics.
Yu et al., 2012. clusterProfiler: an R package for comparing biological themes among gene clusters. OMICS.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: KEGG circle
summary: Circular KEGG pathway overview with pathway groups, counts, ratios, and FDR.
inputHint: Use precomputed KEGG enrichment output with a declared tested background; the circular position is decorative and does not recalculate pathways.

guidance.definition: 把预计算 KEGG 通路以圆形概览展示，颜色、面积分别编码 FDR 与命中数。
guidance.suitableData: 具有明确测试背景、Gene ratio、命中数和 FDR 的 KEGG 富集结果。
guidance.answers: 哪些通路兼具统计证据和命中规模；圆周顺序与距离没有定量含义。

references.citation: Kanehisa & Goto, 2000. KEGG: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes. Nucleic Acids Research.
Yu et al., 2012. clusterProfiler: an R package for comparing biological themes among gene clusters. OMICS.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: GO chord
summary: Term–gene membership links arranged as a compact circular relationship diagram.
inputHint: One row per precomputed GO term–gene membership. Repeat term-level ratio, count, FDR, ontology, and tested background consistently across member rows.

guidance.definition: 以圆形节点和弦线展示 GO term 与成员基因的多对多关系，线宽只编码明确提供的基因效应绝对值。
guidance.suitableData: 预计算 GO term–gene membership 长表，并在同一 term 的各行一致重复背景、ratio、count 与 FDR。
guidance.answers: 哪些基因同时连接多个富集条目，成员效应方向如何；曲率和弧顺序不代表统计距离。

references.citation: Ashburner et al., 2000. Gene Ontology: tool for the unification of biology. Nature Genetics.
Gu et al., 2014. circlize Implements and Enhances Circular Visualization in R. Bioinformatics.
Yu et al., 2012. clusterProfiler: an R package for comparing biological themes among gene clusters. OMICS.

name: Pathway impact
summary: Supplied pathway-topology impact versus FDR with hit-count bubbles.
inputHint: Use impact scores from a documented upstream topology-aware pathway method. Supply ratio, count, FDR, pathway group, and tested background; impact is never inferred here.

guidance.definition: 把上游拓扑感知方法给出的 pathway impact 与 −log10(FDR) 放在正交坐标上，并以点面积表示命中数。
guidance.suitableData: 已由明确算法计算的 pathway impact、FDR、Gene ratio、命中数和背景；不能把普通富集比例伪装成 impact。
guidance.answers: 哪些通路同时有较高拓扑影响和统计证据；影响分数的定义取决于上游方法。

references.citation: Tarca et al., 2009. A novel signaling pathway impact analysis. Bioinformatics.
Kanehisa & Goto, 2000. KEGG: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes. Nucleic Acids Research.

name: NES / FDR summary
summary: Signed normalized enrichment scores with FDR encoded independently.
inputHint: Use precomputed NES and FDR values from a documented ranked-set analysis; include gene ratio and tested background for context.

guidance.definition: 以共同零基线显示带方向的 NES，并独立披露 FDR。
guidance.suitableData: 由 GSEA 或兼容 ranked-set 方法预计算的 NES、FDR、Gene ratio、集合来源和排序背景。
guidance.answers: 哪些基因集富集于排序列表上端或下端，以及证据强弱如何。

references.citation: Subramanian et al., 2005. Gene set enrichment analysis: a knowledge-based approach. PNAS.
Yu et al., 2012. clusterProfiler: an R package for comparing biological themes among gene clusters. OMICS.

name: Multi-GSEA
summary: Multiple supplied running-enrichment curves over one complete common ranked list, with hit positions, NES, and FDR.
inputHint: Provide precomputed running scores and 0/1 hit indicators at representative positions spanning rank 0 through one common ranked-background endpoint for every set. Running ES must be zero at both endpoints; repeat constant per-set NES and FDR.

guidance.definition: 在同一完整共同排序坐标中叠加多个预计算 running-ES 轨迹，并显示各自命中位置、NES 和 FDR。
guidance.suitableData: 每个集合在从 0 到共同 background 端点、足够密集且递增的 rank 网格上的 running ES 与 0/1 hits；两端 ES=0，集合内 NES/FDR 恒定。
guidance.answers: 多个集合的富集方向、峰位置和 hit density 如何在同一排序尺度上比较；曲线只显示上游结果，不重算统计量。

references.citation: Subramanian et al., 2005. Gene set enrichment analysis: a knowledge-based approach. PNAS.

name: Enrichment ridge
summary: Per-term distributions of supplied member-level ranked statistics.
inputHint: Provide member-level statistics for each precomputed enriched term and repeat its FDR, gene ratio, and tested background consistently; density is normalized within term.

guidance.definition: 按富集条目分层绘制成员级排序统计量的核密度，每一条密度独立归一化。
guidance.suitableData: 每个预计算富集条目下的成员基因及其排名统计量，并一致重复 term 的 FDR、ratio 与背景。
guidance.answers: 不同条目的成员统计量主要位于排序的哪一侧、分布是否集中；ridge 高度不能跨条目比较总量。

references.citation: Subramanian et al., 2005. Gene set enrichment analysis: a knowledge-based approach. PNAS.
Silverman, 1986. Density Estimation for Statistics and Data Analysis. Chapman and Hall.

name: Relationship ribbon–bubble
summary: Non-conserved source-to-term relationship ribbons combined with term bubbles for ratios and counts.
inputHint: Use precomputed enrichment rows with source collection, term, gene ratio, hit count, FDR, and tested background. Each ribbon width is an independent ratio; unlike a Sankey flow, widths are not conserved or summed at the source.

guidance.definition: 用非守恒 relationship ribbon 连接来源本体与条目，以每条独立 ribbon 的宽度表示 ratio、bubble 面积近似表示 count；它不是满足流量守恒的 Sankey 图。
guidance.suitableData: 每个预计算富集条目的来源、背景、ratio、count 与 FDR；各 ratio 不要求在来源内相加为固定总量。
guidance.answers: 不同来源关联哪些条目以及单条关联的相对规模如何；面积和宽度不适合精确读数，也不能解释成来源总流量的分配。

references.citation: Yu et al., 2012. clusterProfiler: an R package for comparing biological themes among gene clusters. OMICS.
Schmidt, 2008. The Sankey Diagram in Energy and Material Flow Management. J Ind Ecol.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Geographic point map
summary: Approximate equirectangular site locations with value-sized points.
inputHint: One row per site with decimal latitude, longitude, non-negative value, and optional group. This is a locator map, not a boundary, distance, or area analysis.

guidance.definition: 以等距圆柱投影近似定位经纬度站点，并用点面积表示非负量值。
guidance.suitableData: 十进制度纬度、经度、站点名称与量值；不包含行政边界推断。
guidance.answers: 观察站点大致位于何处、哪些区域量值更大；投影会扭曲距离和面积。

references.citation: Snyder, 1987. Map Projections—A Working Manual. US Geological Survey Professional Paper 1395.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Petal
summary: Decorative radial ranking with value-proportional petal lengths.
inputHint: One row per category with a non-negative value. Use bars or dots when accurate magnitude comparison is required.

guidance.definition: 以花瓣长度近似编码类别值的装饰性径向排名图。
guidance.suitableData: 少量类别及非负汇总值，适合概览或海报式摘要。
guidance.answers: 哪些维度相对突出；角度与花瓣形状降低精确比较能力，正式定量比较优先使用 bar/dot。

references.citation: Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Word cloud
summary: Deterministic word-size overview for qualitative prominence.
inputHint: One row per unique term with a strictly positive weight. Font size supports approximate prominence only; position and color are non-quantitative.

guidance.definition: 以字号近似表示词项权重，并采用确定性网格避免随机位置漂移。
guidance.suitableData: 唯一词项及严格正权重，例如文本频次或主题权重。
guidance.answers: 哪些词更突出；位置、方向和颜色没有数量含义，字号也不适合精确比值判断。

references.citation: Viegas, Wattenberg & Feinberg, 2009. Participatory Visualization with Wordle. IEEE TVCG.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Kaplan–Meier
summary: Kaplan–Meier estimates calculated from subject-level time and event data with censor marks.
inputHint: One row per subject. Event must be 1 for event and 0 for censoring; time must be non-negative.

guidance.definition: 一种处理删失数据的非参数阶梯估计，每个事件时点按条件存活概率的乘积更新生存曲线。
guidance.suitableData: 个体级随访时间、事件状态和可选分组，包含正确记录的删失。
guidance.answers: 随时间推移的事件未发生概率如何，各组生存轨迹何时开始分离。
guidance.origin: Kaplan 与 Meier 在 1958 年发表乘积极限估计，使不同随访长度和右删失能够被统一处理。

references.citation: Kaplan & Meier, 1958. Nonparametric Estimation from Incomplete Observations. JASA.

name: Survival forest
summary: Effect estimates and confidence intervals against an adjustable null reference.
inputHint: Provide model estimates and lower/upper confidence limits from the same model and scale.

guidance.definition: 把多个效应估计及其置信区间逐行排列在共同参考线上；这里的 forest plot 与“随机森林算法”无关。
guidance.suitableData: 同一统计尺度上的效应估计及置信区间，如 HR、OR 或回归系数。
guidance.answers: 各因素或亚组效应的方向、大小和精确度如何，置信区间是否跨越无效线。
guidance.origin: 森林图从荟萃分析的效应量汇总图发展而来，后来也广泛用于 Cox 回归、亚组分析和多变量结果展示。

references.citation: Lewis & Clarke, 2001. Forest plots: trying to see the wood and the trees. BMJ.

name: ROC
summary: Raw multi-model ROC or supplied time-dependent ROC curves with explicit uncertainty and evaluation horizons.
inputHint: Raw mode calculates ROC/AUC from 0/1 outcomes and held-out scores. Time-dependent mode displays upstream estimates and pointwise 95% confidence limits without recomputing censoring-aware statistics.

guidance.definition: 普通模式遍历二分类预测阈值；时间依赖模式显示上游删失感知方法提供的 FPR、TPR、逐点区间、评价时点和 AUC 区间。
guidance.suitableData: 验证集或外部队列的二分类真实标签与连续预测分数，或由明确生存方法计算的时间依赖 ROC 坐标与不确定性。
guidance.answers: 模型区分两类对象的能力和不同阈值下敏感度/特异度权衡如何；时间依赖模式还比较指定时点，但两种模式都不能说明校准或临床效用。
guidance.origin: ROC 的思想源自信号检测问题，随后进入诊断检验和预测模型评价；AUC 可解释为随机阳性样本得分高于随机阴性样本的概率。

references.citation: Hanley & McNeil, 1982. The meaning and use of the area under a ROC curve. Radiology.

name: Funnel
summary: Study effects against precision with inverse-variance center and pseudo 95% funnel limits.
inputHint: One row per independent study estimate. SE must be positive and on the same effect scale; asymmetry is not by itself proof of publication bias.

guidance.definition: 把独立研究的效应量放在横轴、精度 1/SE 放在纵轴，并叠加逆方差中心与伪 95% 漏斗边界。
guidance.suitableData: 同一效应尺度上的研究级估计与正标准误。
guidance.answers: 研究结果是否围绕汇总效应近似对称；不对称也可能来自异质性、小样本效应或方法差异，不能单独证明发表偏倚。
guidance.origin: 漏斗图源于荟萃分析中用于观察小样本效应和结果不对称性的图形诊断方法。

references.citation: Egger et al., 1997. Bias in meta-analysis detected by a simple, graphical test. BMJ.

name: Precision–recall
summary: Precision–recall curves and average precision from binary outcomes and held-out scores.
inputHint: One row per subject per model. Outcome must be 0/1; any continuous held-out ranking score is accepted. Average precision is prevalence-dependent.

guidance.definition: 遍历分类阈值，以召回率为横轴、阳性预测值为纵轴，并计算 average precision。
guidance.suitableData: 二分类结局与独立验证或交叉验证得到的连续分数。
guidance.answers: 在类别不平衡时，模型找回阳性与保持阳性预测值之间的权衡。

references.citation: Saito & Rehmsmeier, 2015. The Precision-Recall Plot Is More Informative than the ROC Plot When Evaluating Binary Classifiers on Imbalanced Datasets. PLoS ONE.
Collins et al., 2015. Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model for Individual Prognosis Or Diagnosis (TRIPOD). Annals of Internal Medicine.

name: Calibration
summary: Grouped observed-versus-predicted calibration with Wilson 95% intervals and identity reference.
inputHint: One row per subject per model. Outcome must be 0/1; prediction must be a held-out probability in [0,1]. Repeated subjects across model names are allowed.

guidance.definition: 按预测概率分箱，比较每箱平均预测概率与实际事件比例，并显示 Wilson 95% 区间和理想对角线。
guidance.suitableData: 0/1 观察结局和真正概率尺度的预测值。
guidance.answers: 预测概率是否系统性过高或过低；分箱图不能替代校准截距、斜率和外部验证。

references.citation: Van Calster et al., 2019. Calibration: the Achilles heel of predictive analytics. BMC Medicine.
Collins et al., 2015. Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model for Individual Prognosis Or Diagnosis (TRIPOD). Annals of Internal Medicine.

name: Decision curve
summary: Net benefit across threshold probabilities with treat-all and treat-none references.
inputHint: One row per subject per model. Outcome must be 0/1; prediction must be a held-out probability in [0,1]. Repeated subjects across model names are allowed.

guidance.definition: 在一系列阈值概率下计算模型净获益，并与 treat-all 和 treat-none 策略比较。
guidance.suitableData: 0/1 结局与验证集预测概率；阈值范围应有临床意义。
guidance.answers: 在给定错判权衡下使用模型是否比全做或全不做更有净获益；不是治疗建议。

references.citation: Vickers & Elkin, 2006. Decision curve analysis: a novel method for evaluating prediction models. Medical Decision Making.
Collins et al., 2015. Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model for Individual Prognosis Or Diagnosis (TRIPOD). Annals of Internal Medicine.

name: Nomogram
summary: Aligned predictor-level point assignments supplied by a documented fitted model.
inputHint: Provide predictor, displayed level, and already-derived points. This renderer does not fit a model or infer individual risk.

guidance.definition: 把已拟合模型中不同预测变量水平转换成对齐的积分标尺。
guidance.suitableData: 上游模型已经给出的 predictor-level points。
guidance.answers: 各变量水平如何贡献模型积分；本图不重新拟合模型，也不能证明临床有效性。

references.citation: Iasonos et al., 2008. How to build and interpret a nomogram for cancer prognosis. Journal of Clinical Oncology.
Collins et al., 2015. Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model for Individual Prognosis Or Diagnosis (TRIPOD). Annals of Internal Medicine.

name: LASSO path
summary: Coefficient trajectories across positive regularization parameters from an upstream penalized model.
inputHint: Provide one row per feature and lambda. Paths are descriptive; model selection and cross-validation must be performed upstream without test-set leakage.

guidance.definition: 展示 L1 正则化参数变化时各特征系数从零进入并收缩的轨迹。
guidance.suitableData: 上游 penalized regression 输出的 lambda、feature、coefficient 长表。
guidance.answers: 不同正则化强度下模型稀疏性和系数稳定性如何；最终 lambda 必须在训练流程内选择。

references.citation: Tibshirani, 1996. Regression Shrinkage and Selection via the Lasso. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society B.
Collins et al., 2015. Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model for Individual Prognosis Or Diagnosis (TRIPOD). Annals of Internal Medicine.

name: Cutoff KM
summary: Kaplan–Meier curves stratified by a single supplied risk-score cutoff.
inputHint: Provide subject-level follow-up, event, risk score, and one constant cutoff derived upstream. Optimizing and evaluating the cutoff in the same cohort is exploratory and optimistic.

guidance.definition: 使用一个明确提供的风险分数截点把受试者分组，再计算 Kaplan–Meier 曲线。
guidance.suitableData: 随访时间、删失事件、连续风险分数和同一常数截点。
guidance.answers: 该预先指定或上游优化截点下两组生存经验分布如何；同队列寻优再评价会夸大差异。

references.citation: Kaplan & Meier, 1958. Nonparametric Estimation from Incomplete Observations. JASA.
Altman et al., 1994. Dangers of using optimal cutpoints in the evaluation of prognostic factors. Journal of the National Cancer Institute.

name: Risk-score panel
summary: Subjects ranked by supplied risk score with an aligned binary-outcome strip.
inputHint: One row per subject with a score and observed 0/1 outcome. This descriptive panel does not estimate discrimination, calibration, or clinical utility.

guidance.definition: 按风险分数排序受试者，并对齐显示二分类结局条带。
guidance.suitableData: 每位受试者一个风险分数和0/1观察结局。
guidance.answers: 分数排序与结局分布的描述性关系；不能替代 ROC、校准、DCA 或外部验证。

references.citation: Collins et al., 2015. Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model for Individual Prognosis Or Diagnosis (TRIPOD). Annals of Internal Medicine.

name: Venn
summary: Exact two-to-seven-set intersections using classic circles or a compact radial exact-intersection layout.
inputHint: Use item–set membership rows, or genomic peak intervals (set, chromosome, start, end). Duplicate rows collapse; peak counts are disjoint atomic genomic segments with constant active-set membership.

guidance.definition: 用经典圆形（2–3 集合）或径向精确交集索引（4–7 集合）表示观察到的集合组合；径向模式不是闭合曲线 Venn 图。
guidance.suitableData: 2–7 个集合的 item–set 成员长表，或带 set、chromosome、start、end 的 genomic peak 区间。
guidance.answers: 少量集合之间独有和共享成员各有多少；size-weighted 模式只是视觉提示，不是面积拟合，仍应以区域数字作为精确计数。
guidance.origin: John Venn 在 1880 年系统化集合关系图；当集合多于三个时，本工具改用可辨认的径向精确交集索引，不把它冒充为经典 Venn 闭合曲线。

references.citation: Venn, 1880. On the Diagrammatic and Mechanical Representation of Propositions and Reasonings. Philosophical Magazine.
Lex et al., 2014. UpSet: Visualization of Intersecting Sets. IEEE TVCG.

name: UpSet
summary: Adaptive ranked exact intersections with a membership matrix, set-size summaries, and downloadable members.
inputHint: Use item–set membership rows, or genomic peak intervals (set, chromosome, start, end). Duplicate rows collapse; peak counts are disjoint atomic genomic segments with constant active-set membership.

guidance.definition: 用点阵列明确标出参与某个交集的集合，再用柱长显示该精确交集的大小。
guidance.suitableData: 两个及以上集合的 item–set 成员关系或 genomic peak 区间，尤其适合交集组合较多的情况。
guidance.answers: 哪些精确集合组合构成主要交集，各交集和单集合规模分别多大，并可下载所选交集的明确成员清单。
guidance.origin: Lex 等人在 2014 年提出 UpSet，目标是把难以扩展到许多集合的 Venn 图转换为可排序、可查询的矩阵视图。

references.citation: Lex et al., 2014. UpSet: Visualization of Intersecting Sets. IEEE TVCG.

name: Sankey
summary: Weighted source-to-target flows with proportional node and ribbon widths.
inputHint: One row per directed flow with a strictly positive weight. Repeated source–target–group rows are aggregated and disclosed.

guidance.definition: 一种有方向的流量图，节点表示阶段或状态，连接带的宽度与从来源流向去向的数量成比例。
guidance.suitableData: 带非负权重的来源—去向或阶段间流量数据。
guidance.answers: 对象、数量或比例如何在类别或阶段之间流动，主要通路在哪里。
guidance.origin: Captain Sankey 在 1898 年用带宽表示蒸汽机能量输入、有效功和损失，因此这种图最初讲的是“量从哪里流到哪里”。

references.citation: Schmidt, 2008. The Sankey Diagram in Energy and Material Flow Management: Part I. J Ind Ecol.
Schmidt, 2008. The Sankey Diagram in Energy and Material Flow Management. J Ind Ecol.

name: Chord
summary: Circular weighted relationships between categorical sectors.
inputHint: One row per categorical relationship with a strictly positive weight. Repeated source–target rows are aggregated; Chord color represents the source sector.

guidance.definition: 把类别排列在圆周上，用圆内带状连线表示类别之间的关系；带宽编码关系量，默认不包含真实空间或基因组坐标。
guidance.suitableData: 类别之间的成对关系及非负权重，类别数量不宜过多。
guidance.answers: 哪些类别之间联系最强，整体关系是否集中于少数节点或模块。
guidance.origin: 现代 Chord diagram 常由邻接矩阵或 from–to 表生成；circlize 等工具把这种通用圆形关系图推广到迁移、通信和生物网络。

references.citation: Gu et al., 2014. circlize Implements and Enhances Circular Visualization in R. Bioinformatics.

name: Alluvial
summary: Weighted cohorts traced across two or more ordered categorical axes.
inputHint: Long format: one row per flow ID and ordered axis. A flow must retain one positive weight across every supplied axis.

guidance.definition: Alluvial 图把同一 flow ID 在多个有序阶段中的类别位置连接起来；每条带宽代表该 cohort 的恒定数量或权重，竖向块表示各阶段的类别总量。
guidance.suitableData: 同一批对象在至少两个有序时间点、状态或分类轴上的去向；每个 flow ID 在各轴应有唯一类别和一致的正权重。
guidance.answers: 同一 cohort 如何跨多个阶段重新分配，主要迁移路径和流失/聚合位置在哪里。阶段顺序来自输入，不由图形推断。
guidance.origin: Alluvial 这一名称借用了冲积层的视觉隐喻；Rosvall 与 Bergstrom 将其用于追踪大型网络中随时间变化的模块结构。

references.citation: Rosvall & Bergstrom, 2010. Mapping Change in Large Networks. PLoS ONE.
Schmidt, 2008. The Sankey Diagram in Energy and Material Flow Management. J Ind Ecol.

name: Ligand–receptor
summary: Directed sender–ligand–receptor–receiver relationships with explicit evidence and weight.
inputHint: One row per supplied ligand–receptor interaction. Weight must be strictly positive and its upstream meaning must be documented.

guidance.definition: 按 sender cell → ligand → receptor → receiver cell 四层展示上游给定的细胞通讯候选关系，线宽编码显式输入的 interaction weight，evidence 字段保留推断或验证来源。
guidance.suitableData: 来自明确配体–受体数据库和上游评分流程的细胞对、配体、受体、权重与证据类型。不同工具的分数不可在未校准时直接比较。
guidance.answers: 哪些细胞群可能通过哪些配体–受体对发生通信，以及候选关系由什么证据支持。表达共现或算法评分不证明直接结合、方向性效应或体内因果。
guidance.origin: 配体–受体网络图随着单细胞转录组细胞通讯推断方法普及而广泛使用，但它本质上是对预定义分子配对与表达/评分结果的结构化展示。

references.citation: Armingol et al., 2021. Deciphering cell–cell interactions and communication from gene expression. Nat Rev Genet.

name: Network
summary: General node–edge network with explicit direction, weight, sign, type, grouping, and isolated-node records.
inputHint: One row per record. Node rows require node and may declare group/type/value; edge rows require source/target and may declare non-negative weight, direction, sign, edge type, and group.

guidance.definition: 通用 network 由节点与边构成：节点颜色编码分组，大小编码可选节点值；边宽编码非负权重，箭头编码方向，颜色编码正/负/中性符号，线型编码关系类型。孤立节点必须用独立 node 记录声明。
guidance.suitableData: 明确区分 node 与 edge 的关系数据。Edge 记录可给 direction、weight、sign、edge type；node 记录可给 group、type、value。布局由所选算法和整数 seed 确定，但几何距离不等于统计距离。
guidance.answers: 哪些对象相连、关系方向与符号是什么、哪些节点具有较高连接度或形成模块。网络中心性外观不证明因果、调控或生物学重要性。
guidance.origin: 图论把对象抽象为顶点和边；现代网络图借助确定性或带随机种子的布局把拓扑结构映射到二维平面。

references.citation: Fruchterman & Reingold, 1991. Graph drawing by force-directed placement. Software: Practice and Experience.
Shannon et al., 2003. Cytoscape: a software environment for integrated models of biomolecular interaction networks. Genome Research.

name: PPI network
summary: Protein–protein interaction network that keeps evidence type and interaction weight explicit.
inputHint: One row per record. Node rows require node and may declare group/type/value; edge rows require source/target and may declare non-negative weight, direction, sign, edge type, and group.

guidance.definition: PPI network 专门表示蛋白质之间的物理或功能相互作用；边默认无向，但仍保留输入的证据类型、权重和方向声明。
guidance.suitableData: 来自明确数据库、实验或评分流程的蛋白–蛋白关系，并应保留物种、数据库版本、证据类型和评分含义。不同来源的分数不可在没有校准时直接比较。
guidance.answers: 候选蛋白是否处于同一相互作用模块、哪些连接由何种证据支持。数据库共现或预测边不等于体内直接结合。

references.citation: Shannon et al., 2003. Cytoscape: a software environment for integrated models of biomolecular interaction networks. Genome Research.
Fruchterman & Reingold, 1991. Graph drawing by force-directed placement. Software: Practice and Experience.

name: ceRNA network
summary: Typed lncRNA/miRNA/mRNA relationship network for explicitly supplied putative ceRNA edges.
inputHint: One row per record. Node rows require node and may declare group/type/value; edge rows require source/target and may declare non-negative weight, direction, sign, edge type, and group.

guidance.definition: ceRNA network 用带类型的 lncRNA/miRNA/mRNA 节点和有向边表达上游给定的竞争性内源 RNA 假设关系；图形不会从相关性自动建立 ceRNA 机制。
guidance.suitableData: 具有 miRNA 靶向证据、表达方向、位点或其他验证依据的候选 ceRNA 关系。应分别保存预测、数据库支持和实验验证等 edge type。
guidance.answers: 哪些 RNA 通过共享 miRNA 形成候选调控结构，以及证据链在何处中断。它是机制假设图，不是因果证明。

references.citation: Salmena et al., 2011. A ceRNA hypothesis: the Rosetta Stone of a hidden RNA language? Cell.
Bartel, 2009. MicroRNAs: target recognition and regulatory functions. Cell.

name: miRNA–target
summary: Directed miRNA-to-target relationships with validation/evidence class retained as edge type.
inputHint: One row per record. Node rows require node and may declare group/type/value; edge rows require source/target and may declare non-negative weight, direction, sign, edge type, and group.

guidance.definition: 从 miRNA 指向靶基因的有向二部网络；箭头表示声明的调控方向，负号通常表示抑制，但必须来自输入而非图形默认推断。
guidance.suitableData: miRNA–target 配对及预测或验证类别、非负权重和可选效应符号。建议保留物种、3′UTR/位点上下文、数据库版本与验证来源。
guidance.answers: 一个 miRNA 可能影响哪些靶点、多个 miRNA 是否汇聚于共同靶基因，以及哪些边具有更强或更直接的证据。

references.citation: Bartel, 2009. MicroRNAs: target recognition and regulatory functions. Cell.
Shannon et al., 2003. Cytoscape: a software environment for integrated models of biomolecular interaction networks. Genome Research.

name: Cnet
summary: Bipartite enriched-term–gene membership network with term and gene nodes kept distinct.
inputHint: One row per record. Node rows require node and may declare group/type/value; edge rows require source/target and may declare non-negative weight, direction, sign, edge type, and group.

guidance.definition: cnet 是富集 term 与 gene 的二部成员网络：term–gene 边表示基因属于对应富集集合，不等同于基因之间存在调控或蛋白互作。
guidance.suitableData: 富集结果中选定的 term–gene membership，可在 node value 中放入基因效应量或 term 显著性，但必须在图注说明尺度。
guidance.answers: 哪些富集条目共享驱动基因，哪些基因连接多个生物学主题。共享成员不会自动证明通路间调控。

references.citation: Yu et al., 2012. clusterProfiler: an R package for comparing biological themes among gene clusters. OMICS.
Shannon et al., 2003. Cytoscape: a software environment for integrated models of biomolecular interaction networks. Genome Research.

name: Enrichment map
summary: Term similarity network whose edge weight represents an explicitly supplied overlap or similarity score.
inputHint: One row per record. Node rows require node and may declare group/type/value; edge rows require source/target and may declare non-negative weight, direction, sign, edge type, and group.

guidance.definition: 把每个富集 term 作为节点，以基因集重叠或相似度作为无向加权边；节点分组可表示上游主题聚类。
guidance.suitableData: 经过明确阈值筛选的富集条目，以及由 Jaccard、overlap coefficient 或其他已记录指标计算的非负 term–term similarity。不同指标不可混用。
guidance.answers: 冗余富集条目如何聚成主题、哪些 term 共享大量成员。它概括 gene-set 重叠，不表示通路因果顺序。

references.citation: Merico et al., 2010. Enrichment Map: a network-based method for gene-set enrichment visualization and interpretation. PLoS ONE.
Yu et al., 2012. clusterProfiler: an R package for comparing biological themes among gene clusters. OMICS.

name: Tree
summary: Parent–child hierarchy drawn as a rooted tree without converting branches into a generic network.
inputHint: One row per unique node with exactly one blank-parent root. Input child order is preserved.

guidance.definition: rooted tree 以唯一父节点关系保存层级；每个非根节点恰有一个 parent，分支位置表示层级与输入子节点顺序，而不是通用网络的力导向距离。
guidance.suitableData: 分类体系、谱系、决策或其他单根无环 parent–child 结构。输入顺序会作为同一父节点下的显示顺序保留。
guidance.answers: 对象如何从根分层展开、每条路径包含哪些父子关系。分支长度在普通 tree 中没有数值含义。

references.citation: Reingold & Tilford, 1981. Tidier drawings of trees. IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering.

name: Dendrogram
summary: Rooted hierarchy whose internal merge heights determine dendrogram branch positions.
inputHint: One row per unique node with one root; leaf heights are zero and every parent height must be at least each child height.

guidance.definition: dendrogram 是层次聚类结果的树形表示，内部节点的 merge height 决定分支高度；叶顺序与合并结构必须由上游聚类结果提供。
guidance.suitableData: 单根无环层级及每个节点的非负 height；叶通常为 0，父节点 height 不得低于任一子节点。距离、链接方法、标准化和叶排序必须在方法中记录。
guidance.answers: 哪些观察对象先合并、各簇在何种不相似度高度汇合。叶片间横向距离只用于排版，不是原始样本距离。

references.citation: Murtagh & Contreras, 2012. Algorithms for hierarchical clustering: an overview. Wiley Interdisciplinary Reviews: Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery.
Reingold & Tilford, 1981. Tidier drawings of trees. IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering.

name: Circos
summary: A shared genomic coordinate system for concentric bars, heatmaps, scatter, labels, fusions, correlations, and links.
inputHint: Each row declares record_type and an explicit chromosome/contig length from one reference build. Link, fusion, and correlation rows additionally need target coordinates and target sequence length.

guidance.definition: 以显式提供的染色体或 contig 长度及真实坐标为唯一圆周骨架，在同一坐标系叠加 bar、heatmap、scatter、label 等同心数据轨道，并把 link、fusion、correlation 精确锚定到两个基因组区间。每个数值轨道独立缩放并显示范围；它不同于只表达类别关系的 Chord。
guidance.suitableData: 同一参考基因组版本下的染色体或 contig 序列长度与安全整数起止坐标、区段数值及区段间连接。每行用 record_type 明确图层语义；correlation 必须为 [-1,1] 的系数，数值记录不得留空。
guidance.answers: 多类事件位于哪些基因组区域，不同轨道是否共定位，跨染色体或远距离连接的整体格局如何。图形不会推断参考版本或结构变异真实性。
guidance.origin: Krzywinski 等人在 2009 年创建 Circos 来展示比较基因组和结构变异；圆内连带只是它众多轨道中的一种。

references.citation: Krzywinski et al., 2009. Circos: An information aesthetic for comparative genomics. Genome Res.

name: Manhattan
summary: Genome-wide association significance across naturally ordered chromosomes.
inputHint: One row per tested variant with a chromosome, positive base-pair position, P value in (0, 1], and optional label.

guidance.definition: 把每个遗传变异按染色体与碱基位置排列在连续基因组轴上，纵轴为 −log10(P)；交替颜色只帮助区分相邻染色体。
guidance.suitableData: GWAS、QTL 或其他全基因组关联检验结果；每行需包含染色体、正整数位置和 (0,1] 内的 P 值。不同基因组版本不可混用；浏览器预览最多 20,000 个位点。
guidance.answers: 哪些基因组区域出现超出预设阈值的关联信号，以及信号是否聚集成区域。它不单独证明因果变异，也不替代群体结构、批次和多重检验控制。
guidance.origin: 这类图因高信号形成类似城市天际线的峰群而得名 Manhattan plot，后成为 GWAS 的标准总览。

references.citation: Turner, 2014. qqman: an R package for visualizing GWAS results using Q-Q and Manhattan plots. bioRxiv.

name: QQ
summary: Observed versus expected −log10 P values for association-calibration assessment.
inputHint: One row per test with a P value in (0, 1]; expected quantiles are calculated from rank using (i − 0.5) / n.

guidance.definition: 将排序后的观测 P 值与均匀零假设下的期望分位数比较，两个轴都显示 −log10(P)。对角线表示整体校准一致。
guidance.suitableData: 同一分析框架产生的一组有效 P 值；应保留全部检验而非只输入显著结果。浏览器预览上限为 20,000 个 P 值，更大分析应使用有记录的确定性子集或上游栅格化流程。
guidance.answers: P 值整体是否接近期望分布，是否存在系统性膨胀、保守性或仅在尾部偏离。偏离可能来自真实多基因信号，也可能来自混杂或模型失配。
guidance.origin: Q–Q plot 源自概率绘图：把样本分位数与理论分位数逐点比较，而不是先汇总为单一统计量。

references.citation: Wilk & Gnanadesikan, 1968. Probability plotting methods for the analysis of data. Biometrika.
Turner, 2014. qqman: an R package for visualizing GWAS results using Q-Q and Manhattan plots. bioRxiv.

name: Chromosome ideogram
summary: Naturally ordered chromosome bars partitioned into supplied cytoband intervals.
inputHint: One row per non-overlapping band with chromosome, zero-based start, end greater than start, optional stain, and band label.

guidance.definition: 按自然染色体顺序排列长度成比例的染色体条，并用输入的细胞遗传学区带区间分割条带。
guidance.suitableData: 与同一参考基因组版本一致的 chromosome/start/end 区带表；stain 可留空，或使用 gneg、gpos25/50/75/100、acen、gvar、stalk，并可附 band 名称。
guidance.answers: 染色体的相对长度、区带边界与目标区域的大体基因组位置。该图不会从坐标自动推断真实着丝粒或细胞遗传学带。

references.citation: Kent et al., 2002. The Human Genome Browser at UCSC. Genome Research.

name: SNP density
summary: Binned variant density along naturally ordered chromosome ideograms.
inputHint: One row per genomic bin with chromosome, zero-based start, end greater than start, and a non-negative variant count or density.

guidance.definition: 把预先划分的基因组窗口沿染色体排列，以颜色强度编码每个窗口的变异计数或密度。
guidance.suitableData: 不重叠或有明确含义的 chromosome/start/end 窗口及非负计数/密度；不同窗口宽度时应优先输入密度而非原始计数。
guidance.answers: 变异在基因组上的疏密是否均匀，哪些染色体区段形成高密度或低密度区域。

references.citation: Yin et al., 2021. CMplot: Circle Manhattan Plot. Genomics Proteomics Bioinformatics.
Kent et al., 2002. The Human Genome Browser at UCSC. Genome Research.

name: Genome tracks
summary: Aligned interval tracks on one shared naturally ordered genomic coordinate system.
inputHint: One row per feature interval with chromosome, zero-based start, end greater than start, track, optional numeric value, and optional label.

guidance.definition: 把多个区间型数据轨道对齐到同一基因组坐标轴；每个轨道保持独立行，位置与宽度都由真实区间决定。
guidance.suitableData: 基因、峰、拷贝数区段、变异或注释等 chromosome/start/end 区间，附 track、可选数值和标签；所有轨道必须使用同一参考版本。
guidance.answers: 不同类型的基因组事件是否在同一位置重叠或邻近，以及一个区域内的多层证据如何对齐。

references.citation: Hahne & Ivanek, 2016. Visualizing Genomic Data Using Gviz and Bioconductor. Methods Mol Biol.
Kent et al., 2002. The Human Genome Browser at UCSC. Genome Research.

name: Mutation waterfall
summary: Samples ranked by total alteration burden with stacked alteration classes.
inputHint: Long format: one row per sample–gene alteration event. Repeated sample–gene rows are retained as multiple alteration classes.

guidance.definition: 按每个样本的事件总数排序，用堆叠柱显示不同 alteration class 对样本总突变/变异负荷的贡献。
guidance.suitableData: 长表 sample–gene–alteration 事件，可包含 SNV、indel、融合和拷贝数类别，预览最多 10,000 个事件。这里的柱高是输入事件数，不是标准化 TMB；无事件样本不会出现在纯事件长表中。
guidance.answers: 队列中哪些样本事件负荷较高，负荷由哪些 alteration class 构成。它不显示每个基因在每个样本中的完整矩阵。

references.citation: Cerami et al., 2012. The cBio Cancer Genomics Portal. Cancer Discovery.
Gu, Eils & Schlesner, 2016. Complex heatmaps reveal patterns and correlations in multidimensional genomic data. Bioinformatics.

name: Oncoplot
summary: Gene-by-sample alteration matrix with optional sample burden and gene-frequency margins.
inputHint: Long format: one row per sample–gene alteration event. Repeated sample–gene rows are retained as multiple alteration classes.

guidance.definition: 以基因为行、样本为列显示 alteration class；上方可给出样本事件数，右侧给出受影响样本比例。一个格可保留多种事件。
guidance.suitableData: 长表 sample–gene–alteration 队列结果，预览最多 10,000 个事件；样本和基因标识必须非空，alteration 类别应定义清楚。纯事件长表不能表示所选基因中完全无事件的样本。
guidance.answers: 常见驱动基因是否互斥或共现，队列的分子异质性与基因频率格局如何。可视共现不等于统计学互斥/共现检验。

references.citation: Gu, Eils & Schlesner, 2016. Complex heatmaps reveal patterns and correlations in multidimensional genomic data. Bioinformatics.
Cerami et al., 2012. The cBio Cancer Genomics Portal. Cancer Discovery.

name: Motif logo
summary: DNA sequence logo from position-specific A/C/G/T probabilities.
inputHint: One row per unique positive integer position. A, C, G, and T must be probabilities in [0, 1] that sum to 1; no small-sample correction is inferred.

guidance.definition: 在每个位置堆叠 A/C/G/T 字母；information 模式中总高度为 2−H bits，各字母高度等于其概率乘以该信息量。
guidance.suitableData: DNA position probability matrix：每个正整数位置唯一，A/C/G/T 均在 [0,1] 且和为 1，最多 60 个位置且还需满足当前画幅的最小字母宽度。输入应已处理 pseudocount；工具不会反推样本量或加入小样本校正。
guidance.answers: 序列 motif 在哪些位置最保守、偏好哪些碱基，以及各位置的不确定性有多大。Probability 模式显示频率而非信息量。
guidance.origin: Schneider 与 Stephens 在 1990 年提出 sequence logo，用堆叠字母同时表达碱基偏好和每个位点的信息含量。

references.citation: Schneider & Stephens, 1990. Sequence logos: a new way to display consensus sequences. Nucleic Acids Research.

name: Pie
summary: Part-to-whole composition encoded by sector angle and area.
inputHint: One row per mutually exclusive category with a non-negative value. Values are normalized to the displayed total.

guidance.definition: 把互斥类别占总量的比例映射为圆形扇区的角度与面积。所有扇区共同构成一个整体。
guidance.suitableData: 单一总体中的非负计数、构成比或资源份额，类别应互斥且数量较少。
guidance.answers: 每个类别占总量多少，以及少数主要部分如何构成整体。精确比较多个相近比例时应优先使用柱状图。
guidance.origin: William Playfair 在 1801 年出版的统计图集中使用圆形分区图。现代饼图由此发展，但面积和角度的比较精度低于共同基线上的长度。

references.citation: Spence, 2005. No Humble Pie: The Origins and Usage of a Statistical Chart. Journal of Educational and Behavioral Statistics.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Donut
summary: Part-to-whole composition with a central total and compact ring geometry.
inputHint: One row per mutually exclusive category with a non-negative value. Values are normalized to the displayed total.

guidance.definition: 在饼图中心留出空白的环形组成图。扇区仍编码整体中的份额，中心用于显示总量而不是第二个变量。
guidance.suitableData: 与饼图相同的互斥非负组成数据，适合需要在中心明确显示总量的紧凑版式。
guidance.answers: 整体由哪些部分构成以及总量是多少。中心孔不会提高相近比例的比较精度。

references.citation: Spence, 2005. No Humble Pie: The Origins and Usage of a Statistical Chart. Journal of Educational and Behavioral Statistics.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Waffle
summary: Approximate part-to-whole composition on a discrete unit grid.
inputHint: One row per mutually exclusive category with a non-negative value. Values are normalized to the displayed total.

guidance.definition: 把总量离散成固定数量的小格，再按比例分配给各类别，是对组成比例的近似计数式表达。
guidance.suitableData: 互斥非负组成数据，适合面向非技术受众展示直观百分比。
guidance.answers: 每 100 个单位中大约有多少属于各类别。小份额会受到网格取整影响，精确值应结合标签。

references.citation: Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.
Spence, 2005. No Humble Pie: The Origins and Usage of a Statistical Chart. Journal of Educational and Behavioral Statistics.

name: Rose
summary: Equal-angle sectors whose areas encode magnitude rather than part-to-whole share.
inputHint: One row per ordered category with a non-negative magnitude. Rows are not normalized to a compositional total.

guidance.definition: 把类别分成等角扇区，以扇区面积编码每一项的数值，因此半径按数值平方根缩放。它比较周期或类别强度，不要求各项相加为整体。
guidance.suitableData: 按时间、方向或阶段排列的非负数值，尤其适合周期模式和同权类别的强度比较。
guidance.answers: 哪些方向或周期阶段更高，整体轮廓是否呈现集中、偏向或季节性。不要把扇区解释为构成比例。
guidance.origin: Florence Nightingale 在 1858 年用极坐标面积图呈现不同死因随月份的变化，使这种图形常被称为 Nightingale rose。

references.citation: Magnello, 2012. Victorian statistical graphics and the iconography of Florence Nightingale's polar area graph. BSHM Bulletin.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Treemap
summary: Nested rectangles encode hierarchical part-to-whole area.
inputHint: One row per unique node. Parent is blank only for the single root. Leaf values must be non-negative; internal totals are calculated from descendants.

guidance.definition: 用嵌套矩形表示树状层级，叶节点面积编码数值，父节点面积由后代汇总。
guidance.suitableData: 具有单一根节点、明确父子关系和非负叶节点数值的层级组成数据。
guidance.answers: 总量在多个层级如何分配，哪些分支和叶节点占据主要份额。细长矩形不适合精确比较。
guidance.origin: Ben Shneiderman 在 1990 年代初提出 tree-map，用二维空间填充方式浏览大型层级文件结构。

references.citation: Shneiderman, 1992. Tree visualization with tree-maps: 2-d space-filling approach. ACM Transactions on Graphics.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Sunburst
summary: Concentric rings encode parent-child hierarchy and descendant share.
inputHint: One row per unique node. Parent is blank only for the single root. Leaf values must be non-negative; internal totals are calculated from descendants.

guidance.definition: 以同心环表示树的深度，父节点扇区沿径向向外展开为子节点，角度编码后代份额。
guidance.suitableData: 具有单一根节点、明确父子关系和非负叶节点数值的层级组成数据。
guidance.answers: 层级路径如何从根部向外展开，各分支在不同深度的相对份额是多少。层级过深时标签会变得拥挤。
guidance.origin: Sunburst 属于径向空间填充层级图。Stasko 与 Zhang 在 2000 年系统研究了这类图的聚焦与导航方法。

references.citation: Stasko & Zhang, 2000. Focus+context display and navigation techniques for enhancing radial, space-filling hierarchy visualizations. IEEE InfoVis.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Radar
summary: Comparable multivariate profiles arranged on shared radial axes.
inputHint: Long format with at least three features per series. Every series must contain the same features on a common, interpretable scale.

guidance.definition: 把多个可比较指标放在从同一中心放射的轴上，并连接同一对象的数值形成多边形轮廓。
guidance.suitableData: 至少三个方向一致、量纲可比或已标准化的指标。每个系列必须包含相同指标集合。
guidance.answers: 对象的多维特征轮廓是否均衡，优势和短板集中在哪些指标。多边形面积不应被当作统计量。
guidance.origin: Kiviat figure 在 1970 年代的软件性能分析中用于同时观察多个指标，后来发展为常见的雷达图。

references.citation: Kolence & Kiviat, 1973. Software Unit Profiles & Kiviat Figures. ACM SIGMETRICS Performance Evaluation Review.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Polar profile
summary: Ordered or cyclic measurements connected around a shared radial scale.
inputHint: Rows follow the angular order. Each series must contain the same ordered categories and non-negative values.

guidance.definition: 把有自然循环顺序的测量放在角度轴上，以半径编码数值并连接为闭合曲线。它强调周期轨迹，不是组成图。
guidance.suitableData: 昼夜、季节、方向、细胞周期阶段等循环顺序数据，各系列应具有相同的角度类别。
guidance.answers: 峰值出现在周期的哪个位置，不同系列的相位、振幅和轮廓是否不同。

references.citation: Kolence & Kiviat, 1973. Software Unit Profiles & Kiviat Figures. ACM SIGMETRICS Performance Evaluation Review.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.

name: Population pyramid
summary: Two non-negative distributions mirrored across a common ordered-category baseline.
inputHint: Long format with exactly two groups and one non-negative value per ordered category/group pair.

guidance.definition: 把两个群体在同一组有序区间上的非负分布分别镜像到中心线两侧，以共同尺度比较形状。
guidance.suitableData: 恰好两个群体在年龄、分期、剂量区间或其他有序类别中的计数或比例。
guidance.answers: 两个群体的分布形状、峰值区间和结构差异在哪里。镜像方向是布局，不代表数值为负。
guidance.origin: 人口学长期使用按年龄和性别镜像排列的条形分布来读取人口结构，后来扩展到其他两组有序分布比较。

references.citation: Wilson, 2016. Visualising the demographic factors which shape population age structure. Demographic Research.
Cleveland & McGill, 1984. Graphical Perception. JASA.
